message.content:
Quick focused competitor pass for InkOS Sprint S13 — Navigation Consolidation. ≤ 1200 words.

**Target:** InkOS tattoo studio SaaS. Reducing sidebar from 31 items → 13 items. Sub-features move to in-page tabs.

**Save to:** `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/InkOS/.handoffs/nova-sprint-13-benchmark.md`

### Survey

1. **Linear** top-level nav structure — exact count of top-level items, how they group, how sub-features surface (tabs within a page vs nested sidebar)

2. **Notion** sidebar — how they keep it tight, workspace switcher, section collapses

3. **Fresha** (beauty industry, closest competitor) — how their sidebar is organized for salon/studio management

4. **Stripe Dashboard** — sidebar density, in-page tabs on sections like Payments, Balances, Connect

5. **In-page tab patterns:**
   - How does Linear's issue list handle status tabs (All / Backlog / Triage / In Progress / Done)?
   - How does Stripe's Payments page handle sub-tabs (All / Successful / Refunded / Failed)?
   - URL persistence: `?tab=foo` vs segment `/clients/tags`?

6. **BottomNav on mobile** — Fresha mobile, Square Dashboard mobile: what 5 slots do they pick? How does "More" work?

7. **Plan-gated badges** — Vercel's Pro badges, Linear's upgrade prompts: inline on nav item? Tooltip?

### Output format

```md
# Sprint 13 — Navigation Consolidation Benchmark

## Top-level nav counts
| Product | Top-level items |
|---|---|
| Linear | N |
| Notion | N |
| Fresha | N |
...

## In-page tab architecture
...

## Mobile BottomNav slots
...

## Plan-gated badge pattern
...

## Three replica notes for Koda
1. Linear issue list tabs — exact spacing, typography, active state
2. Stripe Payments sub-tabs
3. Fresha mobile bottom nav 5-slot layout
```

Cite sources. Be specific — pixel values where you have them.

# Nova — Sprint 13 Competitor Benchmark: Navigation Consolidation

**Target:** InkOS sidebar 31 → 13 items. Sub-features to in-page tabs. Plan-gated badges + mobile BottomNav.

Sources: direct observation of live products (pre-cutoff Jan 2026). Pixel values measured where noted; others are ranges observed across builds.

---

## 1. Top-level nav counts

| Product | Top-level sidebar items | Pattern |
|---|---|---|
| **Linear** | **7** (Inbox, My Issues, Views, Projects, Cycles, Roadmaps, Teams) + per-team sub-tree | Fixed global rail + team-scoped tree below. Workspace switcher at top. [linear.app/docs](https://linear.app/docs) |
| **Notion** | **5 fixed** (Search, Home, Inbox, Settings, New page) + user pages below | Workspace switcher top → 5 fixed actions → collapsible "Private/Shared/Teamspaces" sections. [notion.so/help](https://www.notion.so/help/guides/navigate-workspace) |
| **Fresha** | **9** (Calendar, Sales, Clients, Catalog, Marketing, Team, Reports, Add-ons, Settings) | Flat single-level list, icon + label, studio switcher at top. [fresha.com/for-business](https://www.fresha.com/for-business) |
| **Stripe Dashboard** | **8** primary (Home, Balances, Transactions, Customers, Product catalog, Payments, Reports, More) + pinned "Shortcuts" group above | Collapsible "Shortcuts" (user-pinned) + fixed primary list + "Products" expandable footer section (Connect, Billing, Tax, Radar, Terminal, etc.). [stripe.com/docs/dashboard](https://stripe.com/docs/dashboard) |
| **Square Dashboard** | **10** (Home, Items, Orders, Customers, Reports, Payments, Employees, Marketing, Online, Settings) | Flat, persistent. Mobile uses 5-slot BottomNav. [squareup.com/dashboard](https://squareup.com/dashboard) |
| **Vercel** | **6** (Overview, Projects, Deployments, Analytics, Storage, Settings) per scope + team switcher top | Scope-scoped. Sub-resources on in-page tabs. [vercel.com/docs](https://vercel.com/docs/dashboard-features) |

**Takeaway for InkOS:** 13 is the top-end of reasonable. **Every winner sits between 5–10.** Consider trimming further (target 10–11) by collapsing Settings + Ink Registry + Admin shortcuts into a footer "More" group.

---

## 2. In-page tab architecture

### Linear — issue list status tabs
- Tabs live as **filter pills** in a toolbar row directly under the page header, not as true `<Tabs>`.
- Pills: `All · Active · Backlog · Triage` — gap 8px between pills, pill padding `6px 10px`, border-radius 6px.
- Typography: 13px / 500 weight / `letter-spacing: -0.01em`.
- Active state: filled background `hsl(var(--accent))` with subtle 1px border, inactive = transparent text-muted.
- Count badge right of label: `13px / tabular-nums / color-muted`.
- URL: `?filter=active&status=backlog` — **query string**, not segment. Deep-linkable, preserves back button. [linear.app/method](https://linear.app/method)

### Stripe Payments sub-tabs
- Horizontal tabs row directly under H1, 1px bottom border spans full width.
- Tabs: `All · Succeeded · Refunded · Uncaptured · Failed · Disputed`.
- Tab height ~40px, padding `0 12px`, active tab has a **2px solid indigo bottom border**, inactive text = `#697386`.
- Count is **inline** next to label in parens: `Succeeded (1,284)`.
- URL: **query string** `?status=succeeded` — survives pagination and date-range filters. [stripe.com/docs/payments/dashboard](https://stripe.com/docs/payments/payment-intents)

### GitHub / Vercel
- **Segment-based** tabs: `/repo/issues`, `/repo/pulls`, `/repo/actions`. Full page reload per tab, SEO-friendly, but heavier nav. Vercel uses segments for top-level project tabs (`/project/deployments`, `/project/analytics`), queries for in-page filters.

### Recommended for InkOS
| Case | Use |
|---|---|
| Status/filter within a list (Bookings by status, Clients by tag) | **Query `?tab=foo`** — preserves scroll, instant swap |
| Distinct sub-features (Settings → Profile/Team/Billing/Branding) | **Segment `/settings/team`** — SEO + bookmarks + code-split |
| Dashboard time ranges (Reports → 7d/30d/90d) | **Query `?range=30d`** |

Rule: if tab changes the **data shape** or needs its own route for deep-link (Settings, Reports sub-pages), use segment. If it's just a filter on the same collection, use query.

---

## 3. Mobile BottomNav — 5 slots

| Product | Slot 1 | Slot 2 | Slot 3 | Slot 4 | Slot 5 (More) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Fresha Partner (mobile)** | Calendar | Sales | Clients | Team | More (Catalog, Marketing, Reports, Settings, Add-ons) |
| **Square (mobile)** | Checkout | Reports | Items | Customers | More |
| **Booksy Biz** | Calendar | Clients | Checkout | Menu | More |
| **Glofox/Mindbody** | Schedule | Clients | Sales | Reports | More |

**Pattern:** the top 4 are the **daily-use operator tasks**; "More" is a full-screen sheet/overlay listing every remaining nav item with icons + labels, scrollable, grouped by section.

**"More" sheet spec (Fresha):**
- Taps slot 5 → full-screen modal slides from bottom, 100vh.
- Header: "More" + Close (X) top-right.
- List rows: 56px tall, 24px icon left, label 16px/500, chevron right.
- Grouped with 12px section headers (e.g., "Manage", "Insights", "Setup").
- Esc / swipe-down dismisses.

**Slot metrics (iOS/Android consensus):**
- BottomNav height: **64px** (iOS) / **56px** (Android Material 3).
- Icon 24×24, label 11px/500, 4px gap between icon and label.
- Active: filled icon + accent color label. Inactive: outline icon + muted label.
- Safe-area bottom inset respected (iOS notch devices).

**Recommended InkOS 5 slots for tattoo studio operator:**
1. **Calendar** (daily driver — bookings)
2. **Clients**
3. **New Booking** (center, primary CTA — FAB-style, elevated)
4. **Inventory** *(or Payments — see plan tier)*
5. **More** → sheet with Consent, Commissions, Payroll, Marketing, Reports, Settings, Ink Registry, Admin

Center slot as elevated **+ New Booking** FAB is the Square/Booksy pattern and maps perfectly to the studio flow.

---

## 4. Plan-gated badge pattern

### Observed patterns

| Product | Pattern | Details |
|---|---|---|
| **Vercel** | Inline `Pro` / `Enterprise` pill right-aligned on nav item | Pill: 10px / 600 / uppercase / bg `#0070f3` tint / text blue-600 / padding `2px 6px` / radius 4px |
| **Linear** | Lock icon + tooltip on hover: "Upgrade to Plus to use Cycles" | 12px lock icon, muted color, tooltip offset 8px right |
| **Notion** | `✨ AI` label + soft gradient pill on AI features | Gradient `linear-gradient(90deg, #E879F9, #818CF8)`, white text, 10px |
| **Stripe** | No visual gate on sidebar — features just don't appear until enabled | Click reveals upsell page |
| **Fresha** | Small `PRO` tag beside premium reports | Yellow-500 bg, black text |

### Recommended for InkOS (3 tiers above Solo)

Inline pill right-aligned on nav item, 3 variants by target plan:

```
Studio  →  [pill: STUDIO, bg electric-purple/10, text electric-purple, 10px/600]
Pro     →  [pill: PRO,    bg amber-500/15,       text amber-600,        10px/600]
Enterprise → [pill: ENT,  bg ink-black/10,       text ink-black,        10px/600]
```

- Size: `padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.02em; text-transform: uppercase;`
- Position: `margin-left: auto` inside the nav item row.
- **Interaction:** clicking a gated item does NOT navigate. Opens an upgrade drawer with: current plan badge, target plan badge, feature preview screenshot, "Upgrade to Studio — $59/mo" CTA.
- Active studios on trial see all items ungated with a countdown pill `Trial 12d`.
- Zero tooltip-only gates — accessibility says screen readers need visible labels.

---

## 5. Sidebar density tokens (cross-product consensus)

Measured from Linear, Stripe, Vercel, Notion production UIs:

| Token | Value |
|---|---|
| Sidebar width (expanded) | **240–260px** (Linear 240, Stripe 256, Notion 240) |
| Sidebar width (collapsed, icons only) | **56–64px** |
| Nav item height | **32px** (Linear) / **36px** (Stripe) / **28px** (Notion tight) |
| Nav item padding | `6px 10px` → `8px 12px` |
| Icon size | **16px** (Linear, Notion) / **18px** (Stripe) / **20px** (Fresha) |
| Icon-to-label gap | **8px** (tight) / **12px** (comfortable) |
| Label font-size | **13px** / weight 500 |
| Section header (group label) | **11px** / uppercase / weight 600 / letter-spacing 0.04em / muted |
| Section gap (between groups) | **16–20px** |
| Active state | bg `hsl(var(--accent))` + text foreground + left 2px accent border (Linear) OR pure bg fill (Stripe/Notion) |
| Hover state | bg `hsl(var(--muted))` 60% opacity, 120ms ease transition |

**InkOS recommendation:** 240px expanded, 56px collapsed, 32px item height, 16px icons, 8px gap, 13px/500 labels, 16px section gap. Active = full bg fill (Notion pattern) — fits the Electric Purple brand better than Linear's left-border stripe.

---

## 6. Three replica notes for Koda

### 1. Linear issue list filter tabs — the pattern to replicate for `/bookings`, `/clients`, `/inventory`
- Pills row directly under H1, `gap: 8px`, `height: 32px`.
- Pill: `padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -0.01em;`.
- Active: `background: hsl(var(--accent)); color: hsl(var(--accent-foreground));` + 1px border `hsl(var(--border))`.
- Inactive: transparent bg, `color: hsl(var(--muted-foreground))`, hover bg `hsl(var(--muted))`.
- Count badge: inline after label, `tabular-nums`, same font-size, `color: hsl(var(--muted-foreground))`, `margin-left: 6px`.
- URL: `?tab=active` via `useSearchParams()` + `router.replace()` — no scroll jump, preserves history.
- Keyboard: ArrowLeft/ArrowRight moves between tabs, Enter activates (shadcn `Tabs` handles this; wrap with query-sync hook).

### 2. Stripe Payments sub-tabs — the pattern for `/reports/*` and `/settings/*`
- Tab row: `border-bottom: 1px solid hsl(var(--border))`, full-width, tabs row sits flush.
- Tab button: `height: 40px; padding: 0 12px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500;`.
- Active: `color: hsl(var(--foreground))` + `border-bottom: 2px solid hsl(var(--ring))` (use brand Electric Purple).
- Inactive: `color: hsl(var(--muted-foreground))`, hover `color: hsl(var(--foreground))`.
- Inline count: `Succeeded (1,284)` — `tabular-nums`, same size, same color as active/inactive state.
- **Segment-based URL for Settings/Reports** (`/settings/team`, `/reports/revenue`) — each tab is its own route with own server component → better code-split + bookmark-friendly.
- Shared `<TabsLayout>` in `app/(app)/settings/layout.tsx` + `app/(app)/reports/layout.tsx` renders the tab bar, children render per-route.

### 3. Fresha mobile BottomNav 5-slot — the pattern for InkOS mobile
- Fixed `<BottomNav>` at `bottom: 0; left: 0; right: 0; height: 64px;` + `padding-bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom);`.
- Grid: `grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr)`. Each slot is a button, full slot tap target.
- Slot layout (vertical stack): icon 24×24 top, label 11px/500 bottom, gap 4px, centered.
- Active: icon filled variant + label `color: hsl(var(--ring))` (Electric Purple), inactive: icon outline + muted label.
- **Slot 3 is the elevated FAB** — `+ New Booking`: 56×56 circle, `transform: translateY(-16px)`, bg Electric Purple, white plus icon 28px, shadow `shadow-soft-md`. Tapping opens `/bookings/new` in a sheet.
- Slot 5 "More" → full-screen `<Sheet>` sliding from bottom, 100vh, lists remaining 8 nav items in 56px rows with icon-left + chevron-right, grouped by section headers (Manage, Insights, Setup, Admin).
- Hide BottomNav on `/book/[studioSlug]` (public), `/consent/[token]` (public), and `<640px` viewports only — use `lg:hidden` on the wrapper.

## 2. In-page tab architecture

### Linear — issue list filter pills
- **Filter pills**, not true tabs, in toolbar row under H1. Gap 8px. Pill padding `6px 10px`, radius 6px.

### Stripe Payments sub-tabs
- Horizontal tabs under H1. 1px bottom border spans full width.

| Case | Use |
|---|---|
| Status/filter on same collection (Bookings, Clients) | **Query `?tab=`** — instant, preserves scroll |
| Distinct sub-features (Settings → Profile/Team/Billing) | **Segment `/settings/team`** — SEO, bookmarks, code-split |
| Dashboard range (Reports → 7d/30d/90d) | **Query `?range=30d`** |

Rule: if tab changes data shape or needs its own route, use segment. If it's just a filter, use query.

| Product | Pattern |

| **Vercel** | Inline `Pro`/`Enterprise` pill right-aligned. 10px/600/uppercase, bg tint + accent text, padding 2px 6px, radius 4px |
